scope: Eight new original deterministic mono cues in the real crossing/rehearsal; semantic warnings, actual role/contact/terminal responses and explicit session mute. Actual software output, not physical listening or independent player validation.

brain_activation.method: Read all three indices and current state; selectively searched audio/combat and retrieved complete chapters; consulted combat-response and source P08/P06 sound implementation/provenance.

chapters.ENG-023: Mechanism correctness and creative experience need different evidence.

alternatives: Build variation: central product value, but no inspected specific build weakness justifies adding a class taxonomy before improving current action feedback.
Another encounter: credible content expansion; would leave current role feedback silent and broaden threat scope.
Hold/toggle input modes: potential usability value, but change commitment semantics and need separate evaluation.
Selected original threat/response production, with no music bed or repeated footsteps to compete with warnings.
Unrelated laboratory/extraction: lower priority than the actual consumer.

production_design.intent: Bright three-tap rising bolt versus low rough falling pulse pair; resonant Guardian block versus airy Duelist draw, dry counter, low damage and rising/falling terminal cadences.
production_design.implementation: Deterministic PCM16 mono/22050Hz, 8ms attacks and bounded release envelopes, two -6dB players: threat and response. No Master mutation, random sample dependency, imported media, remote service or spatial localization claim.
production_design.control: F1/F5 toggles sound immediately for session only; existing visual warnings remain. Muted history is consumed, not queued. Pausing/focus/settings/model replacement stop active voices; new attempts are seeded before stepping.
production_design.creative_assessment: Agent inspection verifies readable actual mute/phase presentation and signal properties supporting intended register/rhythm/timbre differences. Critical physical listening, recognition, comfort and preference are unverified; distinct bytes do not prove perceptual distinctness.

before_after.baseline_pcm: All four same-instrument historical-PCK captures have digital peak0/RMS0; inspect baseline-guardian-block.wav.
before_after.restart: Existing sixteen independent keepsake/control continuity operations retained; no new persistent audio preference.

execution_protocol: Run source and delivered PCK with tests/sound_capture.gd through real Dummy AudioServer; initial title is silent.
Prepared Guardian exercise, actual held K/right-facing input: bolt tick0 and accepted block tick60, with preserved player/courier health.
Prepared Duelist exercise, actual K then held W: bolt then accepted draw; prepared floor exercise emits the low pulse warning while walking clear.
Actual F1/F5 mutes; same accepted block produces no output. Pausing midwarning stops it; after draining old audio blocks the paused capture is digital silence.
Prepared normal consumer verifies reachable counter, damaging pulse, gate victory and terminal defeat; model outcomes own cues, and terminal cadence takes response priority.
Export exact runtime-synthesis WAVs; verify their PCM hashes against native metadata. Adverse private copies test silent warning, mute leakage, wrong ownership, changed synthesis and false baseline.
Historical baseline PCK is from git show at446ecd4, not reconstructed current code. Capture script runs externally against it.
Rendered process uses prepared exercises/synthetic InputEventKey commands and bounded Xorg/Godot with cleanup; not full-route OS-key navigation or a participant.
failures_and_refinements: First native build used unsupported Dictionary.fromkeys in the new test helper; replace with an ordinary key set. Interrupted the owned failed application and bounded subsequent direct runs.
A guard test fixture initially crossed impact before the existing60ms startup; correct the test timing, not Combat rules.
Observer attachment could turn past events into present feedback. Consume old history on attachment, seed new attempts explicitly, retain a late-attachment negative control.

Accelerated synthetic terminal cue churn exposed shutdown AudioStreamPlaybackWAV references. Explicit stop/stream cleanup and a bounded0.8s mixer retirement interval remove the final native exit warning. Rendered capture closes cleanly.
Same-directory signal capture timing varies with mixer buffers; compare deterministic model/cue ownership and actual signal bounds, not whole runtime WAV equality.
Xorg llvmpipe cannot change V-Sync; rendering/capture succeeds. No product workaround or hardware timing claim.

continuity.north_star: One actual local_prototype consumer, seven code paths, fourteen capabilities. NS-C03 stays adapted; NS-C07 bounded semantic sound method becomes adapted with code and source/PCK mixer execution. Twelve other states unchanged. No shared-kernel or production-MMORPG integration.
continuity.knowledge: Appended temporal event ownership and signal-versus-perception limits to existing combat-response finding; no new laboratory.
continuity.portfolio: Reactive procedural audio and inspection WAVs in the actual destination; AUD-006 identifies direct destination code, not a relabeled origin master.
continuity.origins: P01-P05/P07/P08/P10/P11 preserved_pending_extraction; P06 pilot_instrumented; P09 seed_only. All original code/media/tests/consumers preserved; no extraction or migration promotion.
continuity.prompt: Unchanged. Existing three-brain activation, primary production mode, real consumer priority and matched evidence boundaries served this increment. Repeated ad-hoc mixer diagnosis cost time; the maintained capture/adverse-check tool now makes future validation direct without adding another lab or prompt rule.

limitations: Actual software AudioServer capture is not physical speaker/headphone listening, device latency, human recognition, preference, learning, fun or accessibility validation.
Short procedural mono cues, no ambient score, voice, spatial audio, production class signatures, final engine selection, exclusive rights or commercial clearance.
Prepared exercises and short normal-consumer setups are not full-route OS-key navigation; existing deterministic full routes remain separate evidence.
Session-only mute is intentionally not a new profile/account/sync contract. Combat, errand, cosmetic and input-profile semantics are preserved.
No multiplayer, MMORPG scale, market/retention evidence, source-brain edits or historical universe/canon merger.
